extinction.rule: flux * 10**(0.4 R E), variance * 10**(0.8 R E); R = H @ R_latent
extinction.euclid: Euclid R from qso_pcolor.band_extinction (SF11 recipe, SVO filter curves)

qso_coordinates.note: QSO colours relative to the magnitude coordinate are independent of it; magnitude dependence lives in the abundance prior.

scope: Full cached eligible sample, Galactic extinction corrected (SFD98, configs/extinction_coefficients.json; DESI North->South relation on uncorrected magnitudes), QSO colours magnitude-independent (fixed broad magnitude coordinate legacy:r), frozen fit/select roles, no S/N training cut or row caps. Four independent QSO slice workers plus four cooperating stellar E-step workers; one numerical thread each. Existing component counts and canonical full-data warm starts. MAP covariance update (Bovy et al. 2011 eqs. 19-20, nu=1, w=0.001 mag^2), selected by configs/map_update_test.json. Predictive early stopping: score a fixed role-3 stopping panel every 20 updates, stop when a block gains < 0.02 nats/object, objective tolerance 1e-4, or 300 updates; keep the best checkpoint including the warm start. Stopping panels are excluded from final assessment. Prepare only unless --fit is explicit. Never change active pointer; no downloads. Calibrate rejection after density fitting.
